title: docs(adr): ADR-0157 working calendars are organization-editable runtime data, resolved by code or refused
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca1jJvsA1dHsPwMiQb

Fixes #35354
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: an ADR records a ruling; the enforcing changes are the three implementation cards.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；这是一份设计记录，把平台工作日历（工作日、节假日、调休）的七条裁决和你后来定的六个细节写成合同，后面三张实现卡照它做。
- 为什么做：来自「平台工作日历」专题；审批超时、服务时效和交期今天都按自然小时算，三个套件需要统一的工作日口径。
- 出错会怎样：只影响后续实现卡的依据，不改任何运行行为；写错了撤回或改这份记录即可。
- 要你做什么：审阅后合入。

## 席位核对

### What changes
- New `docs/adr/0157-working-calendars-are-org-editable-runtime-data-resolved-by-code-or-refused.md`, Status **Accepted (2026-11-19)**, citing ruling 7000950747 and records 7003541720 / 7003566086. D1 to D7 record the seven items of ruling 7000950747 on #35340, one D-item per Scope item of #35354, in the ruling's own terms. Each item's former "Not ruled" line now names the D-entry that completes it.
- D8 to D13 record the maintainer's picks on the six follow-up questions (ruling records 7003541720 and 7003566086 on #35354):
  - D8 Q1 = C: refuse past `maintained_through`; a formula due date reads blank (plus one log line, not an error); Setup gives notice ahead of time.
  - D9 Q2 = C: the approval sweep skips and retries; the displayed due time shows 「日历算不出」 with the reason; the publish-time lint checks only static authoring errors, with no existence check.
  - D10 Q3 = A: an off row has no periods; an on row carries the date's full periods; one row per calendar and date; `24:00` is legal as an end, validated by the calendar itself.
  - D11 Q4 = A: count elapsed time. Skipped or repeated local times resolve through the shared DST-safe primitive (`zonedWallClockToUtcMs`) to the earlier candidate instant.
  - D12 Q5 = A: recompute on every sweep, never stored (the approved #35357 Scope).
  - D13 Q6: no calendar-specific rule; the seed contract of ruling 6631016988 (#30081) stands.
- Open implementation points, listed but not decided: (1) whether a write-time computed due-date column that hits a D8 refusal fails the write or is stored blank, settled in #35356's contract review; (2) whether `maintained_through` may be blank and what blank means, owned by #35355.
- Enforcement names #35355 (objects, calendar service, Setup page), #35356 (the three formula functions, pushdown refusal and lint) and #35357 (`escalation.clock` / `escalation.calendar`).
- Follow-up recorded, not changed: the gantt view's own `skipWeekends` / `holidays` (`ObjectGanttSchema` in `ui/packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`) as a second source of truth.
- `docs/adr/0042-approval-sla-escalation.md`: one dated pointer note at the end of §3 (2026-11-19). It names ADR-0157's second clock (D5) and points to D9 and D12; §1 single-shot and §3 still stand. This was the seat's L2 call (7005187995), so the governed edit reaches the maintainer once.
- Seat L2 delta round (head `aeac9a1280`): ADR-0042 is cited in Builds on and References, and D12's single-shot bullet is relabelled ADR-0042 §1. Open implementation point 3 (one DST rule: where the arithmetic and the zone conversion live) and point 4 (which organisation and authority the calendar service reads under) are added. Nits N1–N8 are fixed.
- `docs/adr/README.md` regenerated by `pnpm adr:index` (generator-owned). Besides the new row and the counts, the regeneration also refreshes the ADR-0137 row, whose status line on `main` had moved without an index regeneration. Draft PR #35370 (ADR-0158) touches the same generated file. Whichever lands second re-runs `pnpm adr:index`; the ADR numbers do not collide.

### Tests
No code. Gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` for this diff (3 paths, ADR-0042 included), run at head `aeac9a1280` (merge base `adcb9f8e2`): 21 of 21 exit 0, reconciled by `--ran` (21 derived, 21 run, 0 NOT MEASURED).

<details><summary>Gate verdict lines</summary>

- `check-adr-links`: 1162 relative link destination(s) under docs/adr/ resolve
- `check:adr-symbol-anchors`: 3798 anchors across 159 records resolve, 0 line anchors (the new `zonedWallClockToUtcMs`, `ClockTimeValueSchema` and `nextUtcCalendarDay` anchors resolve)
- `check:adr-index`: docs/adr/README.md is current
- `check:doc-formula-expressions`: exit 0 after building `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` under the verify lock
- the rest of the 21: exit 0

</details>

### Acceptance notes
- A1: `docs/adr/` ended at 0156 on `origin/main`, so 0157 is free.
- A2: the describe text and JSDoc on `timeoutHours` in `ApprovalEscalationSchema` still say the platform ships no business-hours calendar; D5 names that key.
- A3: recorded as a follow-up only.
- A4: ADR-0144 is the precedent for organization-scoped, admin-written, audited runtime data. The seed contract is `seed.zod.ts` (D13). ADR-0049 carries "inert"; the same-release constraint comes from the #13655 ruling record 5478756633, not from ADR-0049.
- The release-pairing hold in D4 cites the ADR-0144 D9 precedent and says it is the epic PM's placement there, not that ruling's.

### Verification
D12's single-shot bullet is ADR-0042 §1 and is unchanged (anchored at `ApprovalService.runEscalations`); it is a ruling, cited, not a reading of code. The ADR-0042 note is add-only and amends nothing.

Read the Decision section against ruling 7000950747 (D1–D7) and the two ruling records on #35354 (D8–D13). Each D-item should restate one item and add nothing the ruling did not say.

Governed (Tier H): stays draft; landing is the maintainer's.
